observations.statement: Policy-0A exact memoization can be emitted as a residual-judgement DAG whose cache edges require canonical residual equality after unit propagation and reference only states completed earlier in DFS order.
A separately implemented serialized verifier accepted the exact cache certificate and rejected corrupted cache target, Boolean result, residual key and decision context records.
Among 1,200 deterministic random non-affine UNSAT formulas on four and five variables, production Policy-0A and the traced calculus agreed exactly but no formula produced an exact residual cache hit.

The explicit cache-diamond family makes the no-cache policy expand a complete binary selector prefix while exact Policy-0A retains linearly many states and reaches one residual under opposite decision contexts.

The same diamond family has a constant 31-line ordinary Resolution refutation that ignores every selector and private clause, so its cached-versus-tree speedup is not a Formula-Caching-versus-Resolution separation.
On MAJ3-lifted K4, Policy-0A used 4,117 calls, 2,427 unique states and 888 exact cache hits; the unique-state count exceeded the explicit quadratic envelope 1,296.
The MAJ3-K4 JANUS-FC_local certificate contains 50,796 charged records including 37,432 local Resolution events, while exact cache unfolding expands 4,117 calls to 15,671 call occurrences.

MAJ3-K4 has 438 directly reused residual states; all are reached by at least one pair of contexts with opposite decisions, four have empty decision-boundary intersection, and one residual is visited from up to 27 contexts.
Unfolding one cache edge repeats the entire descendant proof subtree, so the set of states repeated in the unfolded execution can be strictly larger than the set of direct cache targets.

Policy-0A stores an exact residual and Boolean result but returns no generalized conflict reason; this places JANUS-FC_local closer to basic Formula Caching than to reason-caching, while its local Resolution pass prevents an unproved identification with either historical system.

The graph-tautology probe produced unique-state counts 1,3,12,40,140,738 for order sizes three through eight while local Resolution attempts rose from 10 to 112,507; this is finite growth evidence only.

Known lower bounds for basic Formula Caching cannot be transferred directly to Policy-0A until robustness under its polynomially budgeted local Resolution additions is proved, and every growth statement must be normalized to actual CNF encoding length.
